title: Small ancient cities in the United States that have never been discovered
place_text: United States (Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Alabama, West Texas)

tellings.quote: there are entire I call them cities, but they're like small ancient cities that have never been discovered that are in the United States.

plain: A researcher of ancient sites named Luke Caverns says there are small ancient cities in the United States that have never been discovered, in places such as Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Alabama and West Texas. Caverns tells Michels this from his own research, mentioning the archaeologist Ed Barnhart along the way, and it would mean America's ancient past is far bigger than the record shows.
